description: Bar count each way, lap splices carried into the total length and into the order, stock bars packed into 20, 40 or 60 ft, weight, intersections and supports, for a slab grid or a continuous footing. Estimate only; confirm with your plans, supplier and local code.

clear.description: Edge clearance. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Optional.

fwidth.description: Footing width. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 40.64. Shown on the site only when "mode=footing" is set.

lap.description: Lap splice length. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Optional.

length.description: Length. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 3.6576.

mats.description: Mats. Shown on the site only when "mode=slab" is set.

nbars.description: Longitudinal bars. Shown on the site only when "mode=footing" is set.

sac.description: Spacing across the width. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 30.48. Shown on the site only when "mode=slab" is set.

sal.description: Spacing along the length. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 30.48. Shown on the site only when "mode=slab" is set.

stockLength.description: Length of the stock bars your supplier sells: ft (imperial) or m (metric). No default: without it no bar count to order is given.

support.description: Bar support spacing. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Optional.

system.description: Unit system the inputs are typed in and the defaults are taken from.

tspace.description: Transverse bar spacing. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=footing" is set.

width.description: Width. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 3.6576. Shown on the site only when "mode=slab" is set.
